subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The old king said, “Good Heavens, I am ruined.”

options.text: The old king was shocked that he was ruined.
The old king blamed heavens that he was ruined.
The old king exclaimed with sorrow that he was ruined.
The old king cried out that good heavens has ruined him.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**The old king exclaimed with sorrow that he was ruined.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To convert a direct speech sentence into indirect speech, follow these rules:
 
• Identify the reporting verb and the reported speech.
 
 
• **Reporting verb**: said
 
• **Reported speech**: "Good Heavens, I am ruined."
 
 
 
• Introduce the reported speech using an appropriate reporting verb, often based on the speaker's tone or emotion. In this case, "exclaimed with sorrow" is an appropriate choice.
 
• Change the pronouns to match the perspective of the reporting speaker. "**I**" should be changed to "**he**."
 
• Adjust the verb tense, if necessary, to reflect the shift from present (direct speech) to past (indirect speech).
 
• In this transformation:
 
 
• "**exclaimed with sorrow**" introduces the reported speech, reflecting the emotional tone.
 
• "**I**" changes to "**he**" to match the perspective of the reporting speaker.
 
• "**am**" changes to "**was**" to adjust the verb tense for indirect speech.
 
 

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer
